title: I’ve created a "desktop companion" game | looking for feedback.
author: Dangerous_Feed6814
selftext:
Hello!

A while ago, I started looking into the concept of "desktop companions" games, that sit on your Windows taskbar and keep you company while you work. I hadn't heard of them before, and I thought it would be interesting to design a simple game, which ended up growing into something much larger. Based on my research, these games should lean toward the "idle" genre, requiring very little active interaction.

I grasped the concept and wanted to put it to the test. Now, I’m looking for people who enjoy this type of game,titles that run in the background without demanding constant attention, yet aren't just about long, tedious waits; they simply flow.

The game features progression, visual upgrades as your settlement grows from a hamlet into a town, and the ability to expand structures. You can even chain buildings together without limits, so you don’t have to check back every 10 minutes.

I’d love for anyone interested to give it a try and share their thoughts. what did you like, and what would you add?

Since it’s this type of game, I decided not to include any "negative events." I discussed this with the only friend I know who likes idle games, but we couldn't reach an agreement.

Should the focus be on rewarding linear growth, the simple pleasure of watching your town evolve and improve? Or should I include events like plagues, wars, or fires, things that could happen even while you’re away, to add an economic challenge?

Here is the link to [itch.io](https://the-burguet.itch.io/mini-kingdom), in case you’d like to download and try it out.

Thanks!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Dangerous_Feed6814 please add some details about how you used AI to develop this. Saying you used AI isn't enough on its own. We're looking for the actual dev details. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process and the actual development. We're trying to keep the sub from filling up with low quality game posts. If this doesn't get updated, it may be removed.
